item.title: 5.0.4-beta.1
item.description:
ExtraDock 5.0.4-beta.1 – Two Identical Monitors, Told Apart! 🖥️🖥️

A targeted beta for anyone running two displays of the same model. If you have that setup, please test it — screen selection, a relaunch, and a few sleep/wake cycles.

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Identical monitors are now separate screens: Two panels of the same model shared one identity, so toggling one screen toggled its twin, removing one removed the other, and per-app placement could land on the wrong panel — each row is now its own screen!
  • Your choice survives sleep and wake: Selecting a screen records the confirmed layout, so a display that comes back with a recycled system ID no longer drags your docks to the other monitor!
  • No more copied display identity: Matching now confirms same-model panels against the display's own UUID and refuses an ambiguous match instead of guessing, so one monitor can never inherit its sibling's hardware identity!
  • A tidier Known Screens list: Screens you hid and leftover ExtraDock 4 entries that nothing references no longer clutter the list, while offline screens that are still assigned stay manageable!
  • ExtraDock 4 screen imports land correctly: A V4 dock pinned to a screen imports as pinned, and a movable one keeps its preferred screen without being locked to it!

🔧 Improvements

  • Consistent app name: The app now presents itself as ExtraDock everywhere in macOS — Finder, the menu bar and System Settings!

🚀 What’s Next?

This fix was verified against the diagnostics two of you sent in, but it still needs a real two-identical-monitor machine. Please select only your secondary screen, relaunch, run a few sleep/wake cycles, then reconnect — and if anything lands on the wrong panel, export Screen Diagnostics and All Dock Diagnostics right away and send them over!

Thank you for helping test ExtraDock 5! Your feedback drives every improvement we make. 💙
